hypothesis: A model with a worse standalone score may improve the strong recipe if its errors complement it. Standalone rank or diversity alone does not establish a blend gain.
recipes: 0.9 same-cut fresh strong SINGLE + 0.1 matched bounded linear
0.9 same-cut fresh strong SINGLE + 0.1 fixed RBF128
cuts: Same3 forward regression and2 group classification cuts from KERN01; no new data or row selection
required: Complete closed parent packet, exact saved class/row ordering and source/recipe/input/split hashes; pristine labels; probabilities canonical and finite, regression original scale. Partial or missing predictions remain null with reason. Do not refit failed arms.
admission: Separate bounded cache audit after all parent workers terminate and root ownership cleanup. No automatic launch, new profile selection or model fit. Root pins its exact source/protocol before any score calculation.
quality: Each recipe must strictly improve every task cut versus exactly the same fresh strong SINGLE predictions. Classification also supported-class and ex-rarest gates. Report per-task results independently and preserve all negative mixtures.
scope: Component blend screen only. It is not the full V16 ensemble, whole-agent comparison, independent hidden test or official score.
